quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of all seven supplied main pages and the accepted correction revision passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Supplied seven-page main only; SI and cited source methods were not inspected.
No measured atomic coordinate asset or numerical unit-cell parameter is supplied. Powder XRD is reported in prose without a displayed pattern or individual-sample assignment.
No physical batch identifiers or mapping from the three TEM-size samples to exact injection/growth settings are supplied.
Vacuum pressure, injection rate, stock preparation, centrifuge settings, purification amounts and dry-storage conditions are unreported.
Molecular, apparatus and morphology illustrations remain presentation pending where explicitly stated.
The three identified TEM outcomes share only the reported preparation family; their exact process-to-size map cannot be reconstructed from this main.
